svg.text: DSP v1 Pipeline POC — one scheduled run (DTE-151), draft 2026-10-28 · numbers match the HLD
list output keys for those hours
keep hours missing any of the 6 publisher files; cap 6
No separate job state: "done" = all configured publisher files exist + manifest entry.
Empty publisher-hour still gets a zero-row file, or FindWork would pick that hour up forever.
State-machine timeout 25 min, so a stuck run can't hold the lock past the next trigger.
FindWork checks only the Parquet bucket, so a failed Writer B hour is not retried (known gap).
write ledger file: ALL rows, before filtering
ledger row = transaction_id, raw publisher label, row hash, source_file, event_ts
Seeded once with ~40M historical ids (monthly files, sorted by transaction_id).
3 semi-join this hour's ids (window: config, default full history)
ids seen on other rows, any publisher (excl. same source_file)
conflicts + reused ids → failed-keys/, reason code (D4, D5)
4 drop Test Account + blank publisher; map 9 labels → 6 (D6)
key = <publisher>-<transaction_id>; drop os_code, make_id (D1, D2, D10)
for each hour in hours[] (2 in parallel) → continued in Part 3
OPEN: parallel hours can each miss an id that appears in the other.
Fix (Paul, #4): run step 3 once over the batch of hours, or concurrency 1 for that step.
Fargate: if Phase 0 says an hour is too big for Lambda, the same image runs as an ECS task.
Part 3 — Writers (A first, B second) and manifest
COPY TO tmp key (zero rows if none)
copy tmp → final key (replaces whole file, D12)
for each of the 6 configured publishers (config file)
overwrite rows for this source_file (same rows as A)
Writer B: may fail, never fails the hour
counts: kept, quarantined by reason; B status
RecordManifest: 1 entry per hour (file, job id, status, rows quarantined)
One-way arrows: nothing on A's path reads from S3 Tables.
Drop the trial and A ships unchanged. Readers: warehouse, Athena, DuckDB read A.
